run_train_transformer_decoder: run the train_transformer_decoder function to train a decoder-only transformer on synthetic data
run_main_training_script: run the main training script to train a transformer on BrainPhoque UTM data and save parameters
create_loss_function: create a loss function for a Haiku-transformed model that computes negative log-likelihood with masking
update_model_parameters: update model parameters using JAX JIT-compiled backpropagation with an optax optimizer
save_trained_parameters: save trained transformer parameters to a .npz file after training completes
